Hello Nadeem,
when I checked the logs it looks like remotestoptransaction didnt worked by checking the config of the charger the parameter you can see why:
},
"AuthorizeRemoteTxRequests": {
"readonly": false,
"value": false
},
you can see that the value is false here so you will not be able to remote stop transaction without changing this value
